proposals.before: In all interrogation, officials who fail to proceed with sincerity and reason but instead apply cruel extralegal torture such as the great hanging rack and Minister Wang's rope—all such methods are forbidden.
proposals.after: In all interrogation, officials who fail to proceed with sincerity and reason but instead apply cruel extralegal torture such as the great hanging rack and Vice Minister Wang's rope—all such methods are forbidden.
proposals.reason: 侍郎 is Vice Minister (or Attendant Gentleman), not full Minister; the eponym should read Vice Minister Wang.

proposals.before: In all cases where in interrogating prisoners they cannot rectify the heart and harmonize the qi, move them with sincerity, stir them with feeling, and deduce with reason, but rashly apply the great hanging rack and Minister Wang's rope, together with cruel punishments outside the law—all are prohibited.
proposals.after: In all cases where in interrogating prisoners they cannot rectify the heart and harmonize the qi, move them with sincerity, stir them with feeling, and deduce with reason, but rashly apply the great hanging rack and Vice Minister Wang's rope, together with cruel punishments outside the law—all are prohibited.
proposals.reason: 侍郎 is Vice Minister, not Minister; align the literal rendering with the office title.

proposals.before: or fabricating seditious speech against the throne: all receive one hundred seven strokes of the staff and exile to Karakorum.
proposals.after: or fabricating seditious speech against the throne: all receive one hundred seven strokes of the staff and exile to Nurgan.
proposals.reason: 奴兒幹 is Nurgan (lower Amur), not Karakorum (和林/哈剌和林).

proposals.before: or rashly fabricating demonic words offending superiors: all receive one hundred seven strokes of the staff and exile to Karakorum.
proposals.after: or rashly fabricating demonic words offending superiors: all receive one hundred seven strokes of the staff and exile to Nurgan.
proposals.reason: 奴兒幹 is Nurgan, not Karakorum.

proposals.before: Of those exiled far, only Jurchens and Koreans are sent to Huguang; all others go to Karakorum and the sea-eagle hunting grounds.
proposals.after: Of those exiled far, only Jurchens and Koreans are sent to Huguang; all others go to Nurgan and the sea-eagle hunting grounds.
proposals.reason: 奴兒幹 is Nurgan, not Karakorum.

proposals.before: In all cases of prisoners exiled far, only Jurchen and Goryeo peoples are exiled to Huguang; the rest are all exiled to Karakorum and places for taking sea eagles.
proposals.after: In all cases of prisoners exiled far, only Jurchen and Goryeo peoples are exiled to Huguang; the rest are all exiled to Nurgan and places for taking sea eagles.
proposals.reason: 奴兒幹 is Nurgan, not Karakorum.

proposals.before: During parents' mourning, committing adultery with or taking a stepmother—each receives one hundred seven strokes and divorce; officials are struck from the roster.
proposals.after: During parents' mourning, committing adultery with or taking a father's concubine (concubine-mother)—each receives one hundred seven strokes and divorce; officials are struck from the roster.
proposals.reason: 庶母 is a father's concubine (concubine-mother), not a stepmother (繼母); the idiomatic rendering misidentifies the kinship term.

proposals.before: When migrating households are sent home by local offices to resume livelihood, using vagrants to seize them is forbidden.
proposals.after: When migrating households are sent home by local offices to resume livelihood, seizing them as stray or lost persons is forbidden.
proposals.reason: 闌遺人 means stray/lost persons (official category for found people/goods), not ordinary 'vagrants'; the idiomatic gloss misreads the legal term.

proposals.before: A man must not take his paternal cousin's wife or his paternal cousin's widow; if he does, it is sentenced as adultery.
proposals.after: Among cross-cousins (gu-biao), a man must not take his cousin's wife in levirate; if he does, it is sentenced as adultery.
proposals.reason: 姑表 denotes cross-cousin kinship (via paternal aunt or maternal kin), not specifically paternal cousins; 'paternal cousin' misstates 姑表.

decisions.reason: s0151 names 王侍郎繩索; 侍郎 is the vice-ministerial office, not full minister, so Vice Minister Wang's rope correctly restores the title.
The same s0151 王侍郎繩索 requires Vice Minister, not Minister, in the literal field as well.
s0200 ends 流奴兒幹; 奴兒幹 is Nurgan, not Karakorum (和林), so the place-name correction is required.
s0200 流奴兒幹 is exile to Nurgan; Karakorum invents a different place and must be replaced in the literal too.
s0217 has 流奴兒幹及取海青之地; 奴兒幹 is Nurgan, not Karakorum, matching the far-exile destination.
s0217 余並流奴兒幹 likewise requires Nurgan in the literal; Karakorum is unsupported by the Chinese.
s0394 奸收庶母 uses 庶母 (father's concubine/concubine-mother), not 繼母; stepmother invents the wrong kinship, and s0395 confirms the same term.
s0313 以闌遺人收之 means receiving/seizing them as 闌遺人 (stray/lost persons), not using vagrants as agents; the proposed gloss restores the legal category.

decisions.after: Among cross-cousins, a man must not take his cousin's wife in levirate; if he does, it is sentenced as adultery.
decisions.reason: s0396 姑表兄弟嫂叔不相收 is a cross-cousin levirate ban, not paternal cousins; the proposal fixes 姑表 but the parenthetical (gu-biao) is awkward in idiomatic English.
